  • Method Details

    • showAuthMenu

      public AutoMenuOption showAuthMenu()
      Displays the authentication menu and returns the option chosen by the user. Keeps prompting until a valid option is entered.

    • showMainMenu

      public MainMenuOption showMainMenu()
      Displays the main menu and returns the option chosen by the user. Keeps prompting until a valid option is entered.

    • showUserProfile

      public void showUserProfile(String clientId, String clientName, List<String> phoneLines, List<String> extraDetails, List<String> historyLines)
      Displays the client's personal details and their full purchase history.
      Parameters:
      clientId - the client's unique ID
      clientName - the client's full name
      phoneLines - each phone formatted as "+ "
      extraDetails - client-type-specific fields (e.g. email, address, NIF); empty for regular clients
      historyLines - each sale formatted as "[date] product info price€"

    • showProductList

      public void showProductList(List<String> productLines)
      Displays a numbered list of products.
      Parameters:
      productLines - each product formatted as a display string

    • showProductDetail

      public void showProductDetail(List<String> productLines, List<String> providerLines)
      Displays the full details of a single product and all providers that sell it.
      Parameters:
      productLines - product header lines (id, name, brand, model)
      providerLines - each provider formatted with name, price and stock

    • showProviderList

      public void showProviderList(List<String> providerLines)
      Displays a numbered list of providers.
      Parameters:
      providerLines - each provider formatted as a display string

    • showProviderDetail

      public void showProviderDetail(List<String> providerLines, List<String> stockLines)
      Displays full details of a single provider and all their available products.
      Parameters:
      providerLines - provider header lines (id, company, cif, phone, email)
      stockLines - each product-stock entry formatted as a display string

    • showShoppingCart

      public void showShoppingCart(List<String> cartLines, double total)
      Displays all items currently in the shopping cart with a running total.
      Parameters:
      cartLines - each item formatted as a display string
      total - the VAT-inclusive total, or -1 if the cart is empty

    • showInvoice

      public void showInvoice(List<String> invoiceLines, double total)
      Displays the final invoice after a successful checkout.
      Parameters:
      invoiceLines - each item formatted as a display string
      total - the VAT-inclusive total

      public String askFullName()

    • askPhoneNumbers

      public List<String[]> askPhoneNumbers()
      Collects one or more phone numbers from the user during registration. Each entry is returned as a String array: [prefix, number]. The country prefix must contain only digits; the phone number must be non-empty digits. The user types an empty line at the prefix prompt to finish entering numbers.
